meta.drift_note: Runtime language selector: design.md/implement.md describe the original design at the time of completion; the current implementation has drifted. design.md/implement.md predate two late-cycle fixes: the bundle lookup must check both `path(forResource:ofType:)` and `resourceURL` to avoid falling back to the system language, and `setLocalizedDateFormatFromTemplate` must be called *after* `formatter.locale`. Pointer: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
